reviews.author: Mark Carmody
reviews.text:
We hired Think Green to replace our irrigation system and redesign the backyard landscaping with new upgraded lighting.
Eric and his crew came in and did a great job with everything.
During the process, Eric kept us involved at every juncture and did a great job of explaining his vision...always happy to hear our input and patient with any changes.
We were also impressed with the attitude of both Eric and the guys. They worked well together as a team and seemed to genuinely enjoy each others company. When Eric spoke to the workers it was always with kindness and respect.
The result is a plant design with a well working irrigation system that now provides us a yard we love spending time in.

reviews.author: Barbara Hallin
reviews.text: The entire team at Think Green was amazing starting with day one when Jason came to our home to see what we needed in our backyard redesign. That was followed by a meeting at their office with a proposed layout of what our backyard redesign would look like. Then the team began actual work on our property….all very personable and they listened to each and every one of our questions and quickly resolved any concerns. They were very conscientious and did a great job cleaning up each day after they were done working. We are very pleased with how it all turned out. We highly recommend Think Green to everyone. Great people, highly professional and a fantastic end result.

reviews.author: Dustin Shafer
reviews.text: The entire process with Think Green was extremely professional, transparent, and high quality. Would highly recommend using them for any project big or small.

reviews.author: lester tukan
reviews.text: I met Think Green early 2021 to undertake a complete makeover of my landscaping.  The design team was very creative and came up with a great design.  The execution of the design went very well.  5 years later I still get excited when I see my landscaping every day.  I have needed their services a couple times long after the warranty period ended to take care of a low voltage lighting issue and a recent irrigation valve leak.  Think Green's responsiveness to my needs has been exemplary and shows the integrity any homeowner is looking for in a company.  I highly recommend them for your landscaping needs.  Jon Riep has been my contact person since the beginning and he is great to work with.

reviews.author: Robert Levitan
reviews.text: We chose Think Green because the design team realized our vision for the shade structure and landscape face-lift from the get go!   Making the pergola reality took some creative thinking but the final project is indeed what we hoped for!   We would and will recommend Think Green Design | Build Landscape>

reviews.author: Michael Colman
reviews.text:
Think Green did a phenomenal job recreating our backyard space. Jon and his team did a great job listening to our needs and designing the space to incorporate everything we wanted. We got designs and quotes from several firms, and Think Green was far and above in terms of quality.

George and the crew doing the work were fantastic! They showed up when they said they would, were knowledgeable, skilled and cleaned up every day before they left.

We love our backyard now thanks to Think Green!

reviews.author: Lauren Gessler
reviews.text:
OUTSTANDING!! I cannot speak highly enough of the ENTIRE team at Think Green.
Jon, the business owner, is extremely professional, fair and honest. I told him exactly what I wanted along with my budget and he made sure to stick to it, while still making sure I was going to be happy with the final product. He truly went above and beyond to get me exactly what I wanted.
Eric and Jeff (the project managers), I also cannot say enough amazing things about! They showed up every single day to meet with me and discuss the plan for the day. They were beyond patient with any questions I had and spent time with me on-site whenever I needed to discuss any part of the renovation. They helped guide me on plant and hardscape decision-making. I could tell this was their passion. These guys are truly the best and such down-to-earth, good humans.
The workers (or “craftsman” I should call them) were on-time (if not early every day!), showed up ready to work, professional, had the most impeccable attention to detail, just to make sure everything was exactly the way I envisioned. I could tell they truly took pride in their work. They were also very respectful and courteous. I even “threw a wrench in the mix” and decided to have my house painted during this renovation and they rolled with it and collaborated with the painters to make sure everything stayed on track and in a timely fashion. Truly, I am blown away by this company (and admittedly, it takes a lot to impress me!)
In a matter of 8 days, about 2 weeks before I was hosting family and friends for Christmas, Think Green turned my backyard (and an area in my front yard) from dirt and weeds to an outdoor dream that I’ve had for the past 3 years! They installed an entire irrigation system, about 30 plants, with beautiful rocks around them, a paver border, grass for my pups to run around in, and a gorgeous gas firepit, that sits on a beautiful paver seating-area, a paver-step walkway from my side gate, and a beautiful pine fence (exactly how I pictured!) to hide my pool equipment. They put in (and compacted) the base for my “future hardscape”(part of Phase 2) around my pool and east side of my house. They also added some plants and rocks to my atrium, making it a serene space for me. They took out some old shrubs in my front yard and gave the front of my house some curb appeal with the pretty plants and paver border. All of this is just “Phase 1” of my project! Needless to say, I would highly recommend hiring them for any landscape/hardscape renovation. I can’t wait for “Phase 2”! (*Note: the “after” photos were taken a couple weeks after they completed the job)

reviews.author: Kathy Cole
reviews.text: We will always "Think Green" and happily recommend this company when we hear of someone looking for landscaping design!  Jon Riep, our designer, was a pleasure to work with and stayed in contact throughout our project.  He incorporated our basic ideas into a gorgeous desert oasis, including new plantings, arroyos, irrigation, and a sidewalk. His recommendations for the design and choices for plantings beautifully added color and texture to our home.  He was extremely responsive to our questions and patient with our revisions.  George, our project manager was great too – personable and knowledgeable, insuring that everything was done to meet our expectations. The crew of Raul, Luis and (another) Jonathan were amazing -- friendly and accommodating; working tirelessly to transform our yard.  We actually missed them when they left!  We cannot say enough about our wonderful experience with this team!  We enjoy our home even more now and relish each new bloom!  Our only regret is that we did not install lighting to show it off night and day!  Thank you! Kathy & Larry

reviews.author: VJ Tolin
reviews.text: Based on their reviews, BBB rating and length of time in business, we had Jason out to estimate a project.  He was prompt on all communications, listened to what we wanted, and presented an estimate in a short period of time.  Ultimately, we had to choose another company but I can  highly recommend you call them for one of your three estimates.

reviews.author: Raulf Noffsinger
reviews.text:
After two decades, the landscaping around our home had deteriorated significantly. We faced multiple issues, including a leaking irrigation system, malfunctioning outdoor lighting, and plants and trees that had grown far beyond their intended size. The situation called for a complete overhaul rather than minor repairs.
In 2018, we engaged Think Green to carry out a comprehensive, two-step revitalization of our yard’s landscaping.  The process required adherence to HOA regulations, and we made sure all necessary approvals were secured before proceeding. Our builder had created a uniform appearance for homes and yards across the community, making it important to maintain a cohesive look while achieving improvements.
Think Green approached the project with creativity and respect for the existing landscape. They assessed which elements could be maintained and added plants and trees with varied colors to fit the overall design.  The transformation was remarkable. Today, our front and rear yards attract frequent compliments and, importantly, require far less maintenance than before.
Another significant benefit of working with Think Green has been their commitment to ongoing service and support. Over the past seven years, whenever we needed advice or help, a simple email or phone call connected us with a familiar and knowledgeable team member. This consistency in staffing has made post-project support both efficient and reassuring.
Based on our experience, we highly recommend Think Green to anyone seeking professional, reliable, and creative landscaping services.

reviews.author: Lia Foy
reviews.text: Thank you, Think Green, for our incredible new backyard! From the day we called to inquire to the day we closed on the project, we received top notch customer service from every single person we worked with — truly amazing. Pricing was very transparent from the start and the team helped us work within our budget to make our yard dreams come true. They worked diligently within their timeline and finished exactly when they said they would. The construction site remained clean and tidy and they even built a makeshift fence for our pool so we had peace of mind with our little one during construction. I cannot thank the entire team at Think Green AZ enough for their hard work and dedication to their craft.

reviews.author: Tom Turner
reviews.text:

reviews.text:

reviews.text: Think Green has been amazing to work with start to finish. From our first meetings with design, to final walkthrough we received consistent communication, had multiple points of contact, and were never left wondering what to expect next. reviews.text: Think Green provided an estimate quickly and completed the work within days. Their team was very professional and easy to work with. We will call them again for any additional projects!

reviews.text: Recently had a project completed by Think Green and it turned out great. The team was responsive from design through construction and worked to make sure the finished product matched our vision.

reviews.author: Stephen Ramey
reviews.text: We contracted with Think Green to completely redesign our front and back yards. Jon was great to work with. We weren't entirely sure what we wanted to do with our property at first, but Jon did an excellent job of planning out a concept that looks really sharp. I would highly recommend Think Green to anyone looking for landscaping or irrigation services. They take pride in their work and displayed honesty and integrity throughout the entire process - a refreshing experience when working with a contractor!

reviews.author: sally brashears
reviews.text:
Think Green just finished up our new backyard. Angelique King is our designer and she is the reason we chose Think Green. Our trust in her was well deserved as she was onsite often and managed the project well. Everyone was on time, and each crew was hardworking,  cleaned up at the end of the day and were all knowledgeable about the project. Angelique worked with us to stay in our budget and no extras were incurred,.
I would highly recommend Angelique and Think Green.
A year later and now on to smaller front yard project. I have to edit my former review and say the response time of our designer is poor at this time.
Sadly, even after speaking with one of the owners, I still have not gotten a call back. The owner was pleasant and advised she would have Angelique call so at least we could get on the books for 12 weeks from now because that is how far out they are. That would have been good since we don't want to do it in the heat. It has been 4 months since Angelique was here to discuss our new project. Guess we have to find a new landscape designer and company. So sad for Think Green. They have too much business now but if that ever changes they will be in trouble due to poor company responses. Apparently the owners have no idea that keeping in touch with clients is of utmost importance  even if telling them of a delay.

reviews.author: Robert Swan
reviews.text: We want to enhance our desert landscape and add new hardscape features to our residence. His professionalism has made us feel comfortable about proceeding to work with Think Green.  While we have not yet engaged them, we are clearly inclined to do so.

reviews.author: Dwight Miller
reviews.text:
Despite some setbacks (Primarily the fall rains that we had) the members of the Think Green team have been absolutely fantastic. They are all dedicated to creating an incredible backyard living space for my wife and me. From the beginning we knew that we had made a great choice when Jon created a backyard so perfect for us that we made absolutely no changes to his design. Jason helped put the project together and was always easily reachable for questions or concerns that we had along the way. Erica was always very pleasant when we needed to contact the office.
Eric and Fred were great project managers. They were very personable and instrumental in keeping things moving forward and communicating with the subs. I could always reach Eric and now consider him a friend. Jeff oversaw our project and was also easy to reach if we had any questions or concerns.
Regarding the subs, the masons, electricians, plumbers and landscape crews were all very nice and extremely hard workers.
Thank you all for making our dream outdoor entertainment area a reality.

Dwight and Danielle Miller

reviews.author: Doug-Pat Hawley
reviews.text: Several months ago we bought an older home in a beautiful development in north Scottsdale. The front yard was overgrown with old plants, the courtyard flagstone was in dangerous condition, and the fountain was falling apart. The backyard was in similar condition, especially the unsafe, flaking flagstone around the pool. Think Green designed a beautiful yard, front and back, redid the lighting, installed new drip irrigation, cut and laid new travertine in the front courtyard and all around the pool. They also put in a paver sidewalk in the front yard and travertine one in the back. Throughout the project they were onsite, frequently discussed the project with us and generally kept us informed every step of the way. The contractors that did the actual labor were excellent and did quality work. We are 100% thrilled with the results. They are easy to work with and honest to a fault. We enthusiastically recommend them to others.
